name: Direct IAM administration (positive, generic folded into specifics)
note: iam:PutUserPolicy + iam:AttachRolePolicy + iam:CreatePolicyVersion on a scoped IAM resource. These concrete actions each trip a SPECIFIC escalation primitive (PUT-INLINE-POLICY / ATTACH-POLICY / POLICY-VERSION) AND the generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN rule. exactFindingIds is the pre-correlation RULE set (rules.js): only DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN fires there (resource is not "*" so no WILDCARD-RESOURCE, and these are non-destructive writes). IAM-705 (tests 4/5 dedup): at the analyze() level the generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN restates the specific primitives, so it is folded into the highest-priority specific (ATTACH-POLICY) as a risk factor rather than reported as its own row. The specific primitives stay as the authoritative rows.

compound.note: IAM-705: the generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN is folded into the highest-priority co-located specific primitive (ATTACH-POLICY). The other specific primitives remain independent top-level rows - they are distinct techniques, not duplicates of the generic.
